nodes.name: Record command
nodes.responsibility: Picks the walkthrough, has it recorded to the file named, and discards the board afterwards when asked

nodes.name: Walkthrough recorder
nodes.responsibility: Runs a recording's two passes: proves ffmpeg first, records the talk in a live page, keeps it, then has it drawn frame by frame

nodes.name: Page driver
nodes.responsibility: Waits until the page is ready, starts it from a user gesture, follows each step, then streams the voice out and reads the talk's events

nodes.name: Replay command
nodes.responsibility: Renders a kept talk to a video again, in either theme, with no voice and no board

nodes.name: Frame renderer
nodes.responsibility: Draws a talk frame by frame on several replay pages at once, each in its own Chromium: every page steps through every frame, and each captures its own seconds for the encoder

nodes.name: Talk files
nodes.responsibility: Says where a talk is kept, writes it as talk.json and voice.wav in one atomic rename, and reads one back through the talk's schema

nodes.name: Video encoder
nodes.responsibility: Finds ffmpeg, proves it has the encoders the file needs, and turns the JPEG frames and the voice into that file

nodes.name: Frame order
nodes.responsibility: Hands the pages' frames to the one ffmpeg in order, holding a frame that arrives before its turn

nodes.name: Recording entry
nodes.responsibility: Accepts a walkthrough recording and runs its capture and rendering

nodes.name: Recording tools
nodes.responsibility: Resolves recording executables and starts the recording browser

nodes.name: Video encoding
nodes.responsibility: Turns the drawn frames and the voice into one video file with ffmpeg, which it finds on the machine or runs through Nix

nodes.name: Workhorse operations
nodes.responsibility: The four things the coordinator may ask of a workhorse, one at a time: delegate, steer, inspect, manage its queue

nodes.name: Workhorse queue
nodes.responsibility: Codex's queue of messages waiting for the workhorse: list, add, edit, reorder, delete, or start one now

nodes.name: Thread link
nodes.responsibility: Which workhorse each tab session and checkout is bound to, and the refusal when a second binding disagrees

nodes.name: Epoch ledger
nodes.responsibility: Which child generation owns which thread, on disk, with operations that commit, roll back or say the outcome is unknown

nodes.name: Codex session
nodes.responsibility: The reviewed methods a turn is actually sent on

nodes.name: Session workhorses
nodes.responsibility: One workhorse for each checkout of a tab session: its starter, queue, operations and context delivery, built on first use

nodes.name: Pane and coordinator doors
nodes.responsibility: Where a pane's command and the coordinator's tool calls reach the workhorse of a checkout, and where the coordinator is told what happens

nodes.name: Turns
nodes.responsibility: What a workhorse does with a turn: delegate, steer, inspect and manage its queue, with the messages waiting behind the running turn

nodes.name: Thread start
nodes.responsibility: Opens a workhorse's thread with its authored instructions and tool manifest, binds it to its tab session and checkout, and records which child generation owns it

nodes.name: Turn execution
nodes.responsibility: Implements delegation, steering, inspection and queue changes through the shared operation runtime

nodes.name: Operation validation
nodes.responsibility: Captures the current binding and classifies both linked threads around each coordinator effect

nodes.name: Operation lifecycle
nodes.responsibility: Stages operations, follows their workhorse turns and settles their outcomes once

nodes.name: Operations contract
nodes.responsibility: Defines the requests, results and notifications of the four workhorse operations

nodes.name: runCliWith
nodes.responsibility: Owns one CLI invocation: help first, then the shared flags, dispatch and the run

nodes.name: Registry
nodes.responsibility: Builds the command registry and resolves a child command

nodes.name: Global flag readers
nodes.responsibility: Takes -C, --board, --doing, --expect-version and --as-session out of argv before a command's parser sees them

nodes.name: dispatchedCommand
nodes.responsibility: Finds the selected contract

nodes.name: Interruptible run
nodes.responsibility: Forwards SIGINT and SIGTERM as an abort, then re-raises the signal once cleanup ends

nodes.name: runCommand
nodes.responsibility: The seam a bound command is run through, with its contract and the signal

nodes.name: Failure reporting
nodes.responsibility: Maps errors to exit codes

nodes.name: Command catalogue
nodes.responsibility: The table of every command, and the caller that hands this module its argv

nodes.name: Help text
nodes.responsibility: The help a reader sees, projected from the table rather than written beside it

nodes.name: Invocation context
nodes.responsibility: Keeps the board, vault, doing line, expected version and writing session for one CLI invocation; stated once with stateInvocation, carried on every request

nodes.name: Command routing
nodes.responsibility: Turns argv and the command table into one bounded invocation; callers outside reach it only through what its index exports

nodes.name: Addressed vault
nodes.responsibility: Asks for the vault a command addresses to be found and registered in one call, says on stderr what that registered or why it could not, and names the vault on every request

nodes.name: Vault finder
nodes.responsibility: Finds a command's vault the way git finds its repository: from -C or the working directory, at the checkout root

nodes.name: Checkout registry
nodes.responsibility: Every checkout and untracked vault known on this machine, the chosen checkout of each repository and a name for each that no other has; every running server watches its file

nodes.name: Bootstrap
nodes.responsibility: Takes the server address out of argv into the environment before any module that reads it loads, and moves a leading -C behind the command name

nodes.name: Command catalogue
nodes.responsibility: The one table of commands: what exists, what it takes and who owns it

nodes.name: Command routing
nodes.responsibility: Addresses one command, captures the global flags and bounds the run

nodes.name: Contract execution
nodes.responsibility: Parses and validates a command's input, runs its handler with the prerequisites it asks for, and presents the answer

nodes.name: Server client
nodes.responsibility: Reads what the server reports about itself, its health and its sync status, and shows a refused board request the way the CLI prints it

nodes.name: Status
nodes.responsibility: status: whether the Archboard server answers, who it is, and what it reports

nodes.name: Command contract
nodes.responsibility: Runs one bound command contract: parse, prerequisites, handler, presentation; callers reach it only through its root files

nodes.name: runCommand
nodes.responsibility: The seam a selected contract is run through, with the argv and the abort signal

nodes.name: Server launcher
nodes.responsibility: Starts the Archboard server, which needs no vault, as a detached child when nothing answers, stops it, and says what answers at its address and how many browsers look at it

nodes.name: Prerequisites
nodes.responsibility: Makes sure what a command needs is there: the server, started when it is not running, and an open canvas

nodes.name: Command startup
nodes.responsibility: Takes argv from the process to one selected command: hands over to the checkout whose source runs, refuses a removed environment variable, finds the command in the table and bounds its run

nodes.name: Server access
nodes.responsibility: Every reach to the Archboard server: the one request path, the board, claim and pane routes with their refusals, starting, stopping and restarting it, and what answers at its address
